suspicious_activity.narrative: Elijah Patton (CUST_0071) engaged in suspicious structuring behavior by executing 68 transactions under $10,000 between February 6, 2025, and July 31, 2025. Notable transactions include $4,834.14 ATM withdrawal on March 2, $4,672.46 wire transfer on February 12, and multiple ACH credits and debits, all designed to evade currency transaction reporting thresholds. The total transaction volume is significantly high relative to his income, indicating potential attempts to conceal the source of funds. This pattern raises concerns of money laundering as it suggests an effort to avoid detection under 31 USC 5324 and 31 CFR 1020.320.
key_indicators: high transaction volume relative to income
